Code and scenery deep-dive

  • Frame of reference. def has sceneryCoordinates:"racing" and startFrac 0, no sceneryStartFrac. All scenery fracs are racing-lap, so no manual _sceneryShift handling appears in the file. The def comment (sepang.js:11-16) records that an earlier 0.95 sceneryStartFrac shifted everything 0.882 and parked the paddock on the back straight.
  • Palm grid. openArea (line 30) is a second, hand-kept copy of the dressingExclusions (def) and bush gating; the two must stay in step.
  • Canopy. 6 petal bays of 4×5 tilted panels on 4 masts and ties (lines 91-130), plus 5 riser steps per segment (131-160). Fabric alternates two tones (lines 107-108). 13.6 k verts is about 4 % of the circuit's props. indexSolid(0.958, 0.020, ...) keeps AI/terrain clear.
  • Guard drops. verify-track reports "suppressed grandstand=1" and modelDiagnostics reports suppressedCounts guardrail 126 and billboard 1 after the engine's pit-complex supersession.
  • Model escapes. canopy overFwd 125.56 m; hospitality kits 0.5-0.64 m right; t1 stand 0.3 m up. Only the canopy matters (defect 7).
  • Real-world cross-check. Brief sources, not re-fetched this session: sepangcircuit.com/architecture, jpkkl.com/?p=2495, sepangcircuit.com/k1-grandstand and /f-grandstand. Length 5543 m, 15 turns and clockwise direction are the brief's figures (Wikipedia / operator). The T15 umbrella canopy is correctly left out (unverified in the brief).

Gallery: weather × time of day × lap position (66 frames)

Orbit camera at six lap positions; trackside added for day/dry only. Downscaled, click to enlarge. Captured with shot.mjs, TLX, SwiftShader.

day · dry

Reference. Saturated deep-blue sky and no horizon haze, against the brief's near-white haze (palette sepang.js:41-48). Ridges are flat-faced slabs.

day · wet

Dimmed sky and a glossy mirror across all grass and dirt, not only the tarmac.

day · rain

Gloomy but clearly daytime (day-wet-lighting merge works). Mirror reflections cover all terrain; palm crowns turn white.

day · storm

Darkest day state, rain streaks visible. Same all-terrain mirror; treeline nearly black.

day · overcast

Looks like dry: sky stays saturated blue, lighting unchanged. Overcast has no visible effect here.

day · fog

Sky stays saturated blue while ground gets pale haze blobs; fog does not reach the sky or horizon.

dusk · dry

Purple sky, heavy yellow-orange wash over the whole scene (overexposed). Lamps already lit.

dusk · rain

Grey overcast sky with lamps lit, wet sheen; warmer and more readable than day-rain.

night · dry

Lamp pools work and the pit straight reads well, but night:false means no authored night scenery beyond lamps.

night · rain

Lamp cones and wet reflections work; background hills are faint teal slabs.

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

#sevdefect, mechanism, fixframes
1HighSky and haze do not match the brief
Day frames show a saturated deep-blue sky with a hard horizon; the brief (docs/tracks/sepang.md §2, §6) wants a bleached near-white horizon and heavy haze. The def sets zenith [0.30,0.50,0.76], horizon [0.86,0.86,0.82] and fogDensity 0.0034 (js/circuits/sepang.js:41-48), but the rendered sky shows neither. Mechanism UNVERIFIED: either the TLX sky path ignores pal.horizon for the dry day state, or the sky is drawn outside fog. Suggested fix: check which pal keys the sky shader consumes (js/lighting/atmosphere.js) and whether fog is applied to it.		all day-dry frames
2HighOvercast has no visible effect
day-overcast is visually the same as day-dry (blue sky, same shadows). Weather response is in js/lighting/atmosphere.js (weather blend, touched by the day-wet-lighting merge), not circuit data. Suggested fix: apply the overcast grey sky and shadow softening on the day path as rain/storm now do.		05-f67orbit-day-overcast vs day-dry
3HighFog leaves the sky untouched and forms patches
In day-fog the sky is full blue while pale haze blobs sit on terrain. Fog should flatten the horizon. Engine side (lighting/fog), not circuit data; sepang's fogDensity 0.0034 (sepang.js:48) is low next to what the brief asks for.		02-f17orbit-day-fog
4HighWet/rain/storm mirror reflects all terrain
Grass, dirt and verges mirror palms and lamps like standing water everywhere, not just on tarmac. Looks like a planar reflection with no roughness mask on terrain materials. Engine/renderer side; verify with renderer-debug before changing circuit data.		day-wet, day-rain, day-storm, dusk-rain, night-rain
5MedDistant hills are flat-faced slabs
ridge() calls build prism slabs: three rings at 130/220/370 m beyond lap radius, counts 50/40/26 (js/circuits/scenery/sepang.js:412-422). They read as cardboard flats with straight tops, an olive tone at day and almost black in rain. Suggested fix: vary height along each ridge and tint toward the fog colour with distance.		all frames, horizon
6MedBlocky dark shadow blotches on tarmac and dirt
Low-resolution dark pixel patches appear under lamps and palms and even on the racing surface (f50 and f67 dry-day frames). Looks like a shadow-map or decal resolution artefact. Engine side; not tied to a sepang prop.		03-f33/04-f50/05-f67 day-dry
7MedMain canopy declared bounds are far too small
The audit reports overFwd 125.56 m for sepang-main-grandstand-canopy: its modelGroup box is size [26,34,88] (sepang.js:163-164) but the emitter spans along(0.960,0.015) plus bays out to 0.010, roughly 300 m of track. A wrong declared box can break culling, footprint validation and landmark checks. Suggested fix: size ~[26,34,~305] centred at s=0.9875. Measured (audit diagnostics), cause inferred.		none visible; model diagnostics
8MedDead and suppressed emitters
(a) Five sepang-pit-bay-N groups are always suppressed as 'superseded by the pit complex' (sepang.js:175, ~30 lines of dead code). (b) sepang-shade-walk-t1 is rejected, footprint rejected (sepang.js:468). (c) 126 guardrail segments, 1 billboard and 1 grandstand are dropped by guards (guardrail calls sepang.js:401-402; billboard list 274-278). Suggested fix: delete (a) and (b); re-seat or drop the guardrail ranges that collide.		verify-track output: 'suppressed grandstand=1'
9MedDusk is overexposed
dusk-dry is washed in a heavy yellow-orange glow over everything; detail in the road and infield is lost. Lighting presets / fog colour at dusk (lighting-tuner territory), not circuit data.		03-f33orbit-dusk-dry
10LowMonsoon drains not visible
The brief says drains should always be visible (§5). waterBand north 0.18-0.28 and south 0.62-0.72 (sepang.js:397-398) emit 588 verts of water, yet no water is seen in the f17 or f67 frames; at gap 30-36 m they may sit behind the palm rows or read as dirt. UNVERIFIED which.		02-f17, 05-f67
11LowPlantation reads as scattered, not an ordered grid
Front-rank palms line up but the far ranks (stripped cones, sepang.js:46-52, spacing 26 m / rank step 14 m) read as irregular green cones; the brief's signature is strict regularity. Low priority.		04-f50, 06-f83
12LowTrack narrower than the real circuit
baseHW 8 gives 16 m, with 13.2 m at T15 and 13.8 m at T9 (hwZones, sepang.js:50-54). Brief cites 16-22 m wide; no hwZone widens the straights. Source claim, not independently verified.		geometry
13LowLength 0.7 % short of official
Built 5502.6 m against official 5543 m (brief citing Wikipedia/operator) and 5555 m for the OSM trace. def.lengthKm is rounded to 5.5 (sepang.js:28). Within normal import tolerance; note only.		geometry

Not captured / uncertain

  • Dusk and night only orbit, dry and rain; no trackside/eye frames outside day/dry. Dawn, night fog/storm and overcast were not captured. Eye (cockpit) view not captured.
  • The frac 0.00 trackside frame faces a plain wall (camera placement against the pit-side structure), so it shows no scenery; treat it as a placement miss, not a prop defect.
  • Each weather/time group was captured once; no repeat to rule out per-run variance.
  • Sky and haze mechanism (defect 1) is a visual finding with a hypothesised cause; not traced in the renderer.
  • Corner directions beyond T1 and real-world turn geometry were not checked against a map; elevation values were not compared to surveyed data.
  • Drain visibility (defect 10) is not confirmed either way: no close view of s 0.18-0.28 L was captured.
  • No non-orbit view of the canopy interior or of the T1 stand; stand and canopy faults not inspected up close.
  • Gallery builder check: build-gallery.cjs --out=DIR (the --help text says --out DIR, which is ignored and writes to gallery/tracks) indexed all 66 sepang frames, but the 6 storm frames parse as tod "unknown": WEATHER_TAIL in tools/track/build-gallery.cjs has no storm.
  • Filenames follow GALLERY.md (sepang-nn-sector-tod-condition.png), not weather-before-time, so the gallery builder parses them.
